general_disclaimer: This advisory is generated by PlantScan AI for preliminary screening and educational purposes. Agro-climatic conditions, local pest resistance, and crop growth stages vary. Always consult your local agricultural extension service, Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK), or a certified agronomist before making major farm management decisions.
chemical_safety_warning: DANGER / CAUTION: Synthetic chemicals and pesticides must be handled strictly according to manufacturer label instructions and local regulatory approvals. Always wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE: gloves, eye protection, respirator/mask, boots). Observe mandatory pre-harvest intervals (PHI) and re-entry intervals (REI). Do not spray during windy conditions or near water sources to protect pollinators and aquatic ecosystems.
organic_guidance_note: Organic and biological controls are recommended as first-line measures under Integrated Pest Management (IPM) to promote soil microbiome health and minimize chemical residue.
uncertainty_notice: When AI diagnostic confidence is below the threshold or visual features are ambiguous, avoid treating based on presumption. Re-examine the crop under natural daylight or take physical samples to an agricultural clinic.
